subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Vehicle-to-Grid Technology
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Vehicle-to-Grid Technology.

hook.text: What if your parked EV could sell its stored energy back to the power grid during peak demand?

buildup.text: Vehicle-to-grid, or V2G, turns millions of parked EVs into a distributed battery for the electric grid.

discovery.text: During a heatwave or power shortage, the grid could draw a little energy from every plugged-in car.

twist.text: Car owners would earn money by lending their battery, turning their parked car into a tiny power plant.

climax.text: Pilot programs in the UK and Japan show V2G working, but battery wear concerns slow mass adoption.

punchline.text: Your parked car could power your neighbor's house.

quiz.question: What does vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technology do?
options: Sends stored EV energy back to the power grid
Powers the car from solar panels

details.summary: Vehicle-to-grid technology lets EVs discharge stored energy back into the power grid during peak demand, turning parked cars into a distributed battery network that stabilizes electricity supply.
details.whyItMatters: Millions of EVs collectively store enormous amounts of energy. V2G could help balance the grid, integrate more renewable power, and even let EV owners earn money by selling stored energy back.
takeaways: Bidirectional chargers allow power to flow from car to grid
Parked EVs can supply peak power and reduce grid strain
Owners could earn credits by participating in V2G programs

faq.question: Does sending power back to the grid degrade the EV battery faster?
faq.answer: Additional charge-discharge cycles do cause some extra wear, but V2G systems typically use shallow cycles that minimize degradation. The financial return from grid services can offset any marginal battery cost.

faq.question: Which EVs currently support vehicle-to-grid capability?
faq.answer: The Nissan Leaf was an early V2G pioneer via CHAdeMO. The Ford F-150 Lightning and Hyundai Ioniq 5 support bidirectional power output. More manufacturers are adding V2G capability to new models.
